title_tag: 全球12亿台摄像头，正在变成免费“战争眼睛”！普通人的摄像头，怎么成了现代战争的新目标？—— 美国《华尔街日报》外刊讲解第1199天
h1: 全球12亿台摄像头，正在变成免费“战争眼睛”！普通人的摄像头，怎么成了现代战争的新目标？
category: 美国《华尔街日报》外刊讲解 第1199天

headline.en_html: Video Cameras Are Everywhere—and Now They Are Being Hacked for War
headline.zh: 摄像头无处不在——如今，它们正被黑客入侵，沦为战争工具

notes.en: a camera used to record moving images, sometimes connected to the internet for remote monitoring
notes.ctx: 指遍布日常的各类摄像设备，从家用监控、门铃到婴儿监视器，本文特指其中能联网、可被远程访问的那一批。
notes.ex1: Video cameras are widely used to monitor homes and public spaces. 摄像头被广泛用于监控家庭和公共场所。
notes.ex2: Internet-connected video cameras can become targets for hackers. 联网摄像头可能成为黑客攻击的目标。

notes.en: to gain unauthorized access to a computer system, device or network
notes.zh: 非法入侵（计算机系统）；黑入；破解
notes.ctx: 指黑客未经授权侵入联网摄像头，夺取画面甚至控制设备，让民用安防设备沦为军事情报工具；标题的 are being hacked 是现在进行时被动，强调正持续遭到入侵。
notes.ex1: Hackers managed to hack into the company’s security system. 黑客成功入侵了公司的安全系统。
notes.ex2: The family discovered that their baby monitor had been hacked. 这家人发现，他们的婴儿监视器遭到了黑客入侵。

paragraphs.en_html: As U.S. and Israeli forces bombed Iran early this year, a <mark class="voc">poultry</mark> farmer in northern Israel decided to check on his chickens. When he <mark class="voc">launched</mark> the app on his phone for the webcam outside his <mark class="voc">coop</mark>, he was alarmed to see that its language had been switched to Arabic. He contacted Israel’s National Cyber Directorate, which found that hackers had <mark class="voc">taken control of</mark> the Chinese-made camera. They weren’t interested in chickens. The camera’s <mark class="voc">orientation</mark> on the coop offered it a <mark class="voc">line of sight</mark> to the movements of Israeli security forces along the nearby border with Lebanon. The cyber directorate said it helped the farmer <mark class="voc">harden</mark> the camera’s security and adjust its viewing angle to stop capturing military operations.
paragraphs.zh: 今年早些时候，当美国和以色列军队轰炸伊朗时，以色列北部的一名家禽养殖户决定查看一下自己的鸡群。他打开手机上的应用程序，想查看鸡舍外的网络摄像头，却惊恐地发现，摄像头的操作语言竟然被切换成了阿拉伯语。他随即联系了以色列国家网络安全局。调查发现，黑客已经控制了这台中国制造的摄像头。然而，他们感兴趣的并不是鸡。由于摄像头安装在鸡舍上的朝向，它恰好能够拍摄到附近黎巴嫩边境一带以色列安全部队的活动。以色列国家网络安全局表示，他们帮助这名农户加强了摄像头的安全防护，并调整了拍摄角度，以防止其继续捕捉军事行动的画面。

notes.en: domestic birds, such as chickens, ducks and turkeys, raised for their meat or eggs
notes.ctx: 此处特指农户养的那群鸡；poultry farmer 即家禽养殖户，一个最不可能与战争沾边的身份。
notes.ex1: The farmer raises poultry on a small piece of land outside the village. 这名农户在村外的一小块土地上饲养家禽。
notes.ex2: Rising feed prices have increased the cost of poultry production. 饲料价格上涨推高了家禽养殖成本。

notes.en: to start or open a computer program or application
notes.ctx: 这里指打开手机应用程序；launch 的核心是让某事物开始运行，火箭发射、产品发布、软件启动用的都是它。
notes.ex1: She launched the app to check the security cameras at home. 她打开应用程序，查看家中的安防摄像头。
notes.ex2: The company plans to launch a new streaming service next month. 该公司计划下个月推出一项新的流媒体服务。

notes.en: a small building or enclosed space where chickens or other poultry are kept
notes.ctx: 指农户装摄像头的地方——镜头本是对着鸡的，却顺带把附近的军事活动也框了进去。
notes.ex1: The farmer installed a camera outside the chicken coop. 农户在鸡舍外安装了一台摄像头。
notes.ex2: The chickens returned to their coop before sunset. 日落前，鸡群回到了鸡舍。

notes.en: to gain the power to operate, direct or manage something
notes.ctx: 指黑客通过网络入侵夺得摄像头控制权，既能操纵设备，也能拿到它拍到的画面。
notes.ex1: Hackers took control of several security cameras in the building. 黑客控制了大楼里的数台安防摄像头。
notes.ex2: The new management team took control of the company after the acquisition. 收购完成后，新的管理团队接管了公司。

notes.en: the direction in which something is positioned or facing
notes.ctx: 指摄像头的安装朝向——正因镜头恰好对准边境军事活动区，一台看鸡的设备才成了情报工具。
notes.ex1: The orientation of the camera determines which areas it can capture. 摄像头的朝向决定了它能够拍摄哪些区域。
notes.ex2: The orientation of the building allows more sunlight to enter the rooms. 建筑物的朝向使更多阳光能够照进房间。

notes.en: a clear, unobstructed view between an observer and an object
notes.zh: 视线，视野范围；直视路径
notes.ctx: 指摄像头能直接望见以色列安全部队活动的那条视野，正因无遮挡，才具备军事情报价值。
notes.ex1: The camera had a clear line of sight to the entrance of the military base. 摄像头能够清楚地拍摄到军事基地的入口。
notes.ex2: Tall buildings blocked our line of sight to the sea. 高楼挡住了我们望向大海的视线。

notes.en: to make something stronger or more resistant to damage or attack
notes.ctx: 此处是网络安全意义上的系统加固，不是物理变硬——让摄像头更难被攻破。
notes.ex1: The company hardened its network security after a series of cyberattacks. 在遭遇一系列网络攻击后，该公司加强了网络安全防护。
notes.ex2: Organizations should harden their devices against unauthorized access. 各机构应加强设备防护，防止未经授权的访问。

paragraphs.en_html: The farmer’s webcam was one of an estimated 1.2 billion internet-connected cameras worldwide, according to cybersecurity consultants S-RM. The devices have become a background <mark class="voc">fixture</mark> of daily life in the form of security systems, doorbells, traffic controls and even baby monitors—and potentially any of them are <mark class="voc">vulnerable</mark> to <mark class="voc">snooping</mark>, say cybersecurity experts and hackers. “We are now seeing the <mark class="voc">conversion</mark> of civilian <mark class="voc">surveillance</mark> into wartime intelligence collection,” said Alexander Leslie, a national-security expert at threat-intelligence consultants Recorded Future, who sees a global “<mark class="voc">soft underbelly</mark>” in <mark class="voc">omnipresent</mark> digital eyeballs.
paragraphs.zh: 据网络安全咨询公司S-RM估计，全球约有12亿台联网摄像头，而这名农户的网络摄像头只是其中之一。这些设备早已以安防系统、门铃、交通监控设备，甚至婴儿监视器等形式，成为日常生活中几乎不被察觉的固定存在。然而，网络安全专家和黑客指出，其中任何一台设备都可能遭到窥探。威胁情报咨询公司Recorded Future的国家安全专家亚历山大·莱斯利表示：“我们如今正在目睹民用监控向战时情报收集工具的转变。”在他看来，这些无处不在的“数字眼睛”，正在全球范围内形成一处脆弱的软肋。

notes.en: something that is permanently or regularly present in a particular place or situation
notes.zh: 固定设施；长期存在的事物
notes.ctx: 指习以为常、几乎不再引人注意的存在；background fixture 强调摄像头早已悄然融进生活的背景。
notes.ex1: Smartphones have become a fixture of modern life. 智能手机已经成为现代生活中不可或缺的一部分。
notes.ex2: The old bookstore has been a fixture of the neighborhood for decades. 这家老书店几十年来一直是社区里熟悉的存在。

notes.en: easily harmed, attacked or affected by something dangerous
notes.ctx: 指联网摄像头在防护不足时容易被人入侵、被人窥探，是本文的关键定性词。
notes.ex1: Poorly protected devices are particularly vulnerable to cyberattacks. 安全防护薄弱的设备尤其容易遭受网络攻击。
notes.ex2: Children are more vulnerable to certain online risks. 儿童更容易受到某些网络风险的影响。

notes.en: to secretly look at or investigate someone’s private activities or information
notes.ctx: 指未经允许借摄像头偷看他人的生活、活动或敏感信息；snooping 即网络环境下的非法窥探。
notes.ex1: Hackers used the camera to snoop on the family’s private life. 黑客利用摄像头窥探这家人的私人生活。
notes.ex2: She suspected that someone had been snooping through her emails. 她怀疑有人一直在偷看她的电子邮件。

notes.en: the process of changing something from one form, purpose or use to another
notes.ctx: 指民用监控设备被改造成战时情报收集工具，强调同一项技术用途的整体翻转。
notes.ex1: The conversion of civilian technology into military tools raises serious concerns. 将民用技术转变为军事工具引发了严重担忧。
notes.ex2: The factory underwent a conversion from car production to battery manufacturing. 这家工厂从汽车生产转向了电池制造。

notes.en: the careful and continuous observation of people, places or activities
notes.ctx: 指借摄像设备持续观察人员与环境；civilian surveillance 是民用监控，wartime intelligence collection 是战时情报收集。
notes.ex1: The authorities increased surveillance around sensitive facilities. 当局加强了对敏感设施周边的监控。
notes.ex2: Mass surveillance has raised concerns about personal privacy. 大规模监控引发了人们对个人隐私的担忧。

notes.en: the weakest or most vulnerable part of a system, organization or situation
notes.zh: 软肋，薄弱环节，易受攻击之处
notes.ctx: 指全球铺开的联网摄像头构成的网络安全软肋；underbelly 原指动物柔软的腹部，比喻看似强大的数字设施最经不起打的地方。
notes.ex1: Outdated software has become the soft underbelly of many organizations’ cybersecurity systems. 过时的软件已经成为许多机构网络安全体系的软肋。
notes.ex2: The crisis exposed the soft underbelly of the country’s economy. 这场危机暴露了该国经济的薄弱环节。

notes.en: present or found everywhere at the same time
notes.zh: 无处不在的，遍布各处的
notes.ctx: 形容摄像头遍布现代社会的每个角落；omnipresent digital eyeballs 就是把摄像头写成无处不在的数字眼睛。
notes.ex1: Security cameras have become almost omnipresent in major cities. 安防摄像头在大城市中几乎无处不在。
notes.ex2: Social media is an omnipresent influence in the lives of young people. 社交媒体对年轻人的生活产生着无处不在的影响。

paragraphs.en_html: Intelligence agencies <mark class="voc">scour</mark> the internet for vulnerable cameras and robotically <mark class="voc">tap into</mark> them by testing millions of passwords. Now, AI has made it even easier to hack into them and analyze their data <mark class="voc">at scale</mark>, transforming cameras that were designed to boost safety into tools for <mark class="voc">combatants</mark> to track, surveil and attack the enemy—often <mark class="voc">surpassing</mark> the abilities of human intelligence analysts. Algorithms digest endless <mark class="voc">reams</mark> of footage to find <mark class="voc">hidden gems</mark> and patterns for agents to monitor.
paragraphs.zh: 情报机构在互联网上四处搜寻存在安全漏洞的摄像头，并通过自动化程序测试数百万个密码，尝试接入这些设备。如今，人工智能使入侵摄像头以及大规模分析其数据变得更加容易。那些原本旨在提高安全性的摄像头，正被改造成交战方追踪、监视和攻击敌人的工具，其能力甚至常常超越人类情报分析员。算法能够处理海量、源源不断的视频画面，从中发现值得情报人员关注的隐藏线索和规律。

notes.en: to search a place or collection of information very thoroughly
notes.ctx: 指情报机构在网上大范围、细致地搜罗有漏洞的摄像头，比 search 更强调搜得全、搜得透。
notes.ex1: Investigators scoured the internet for evidence of the cyberattack. 调查人员在互联网上仔细搜寻网络攻击的证据。
notes.ex2: Rescue teams scoured the forest for the missing hikers. 救援队彻底搜查了森林，寻找失踪的徒步者。

notes.en: to gain access to or make use of a source of information, power or resources
notes.ctx: 指通过撞库测试密码等方式接进摄像头，拿走画面与数据，重点在“未经授权”地进入设备。
notes.ex1: Hackers attempted to tap into the building’s security cameras. 黑客试图接入大楼的安防摄像头。
notes.ex2: The company hopes to tap into new markets in Southeast Asia. 该公司希望开拓东南亚的新市场。

notes.en: on a large scale, involving large amounts of data, people or activity
notes.ctx: 指借 AI 对海量摄像头及其视频做规模化分析，不再靠人一台一台地看。
notes.ex1: AI can analyze enormous amounts of video footage at scale. 人工智能能够大规模分析海量视频画面。
notes.ex2: The company struggled to deliver its services at scale. 该公司难以大规模提供服务。

notes.en: a person, group or country that takes part in armed conflict
notes.ctx: 指参与战争或武装冲突的一方，这里指利用被入侵摄像头获取军事情报的交战势力。
notes.ex1: Both combatants relied heavily on digital intelligence during the conflict. 冲突双方都高度依赖数字情报。
notes.ex2: International law distinguishes between combatants and civilians. 国际法对战斗人员和平民作出了区分。

notes.en: to do or be better than someone or something; to exceed a particular level
notes.ctx: 指 AI 分析海量监控数据的能力，在某些方面已经压过人类情报分析员。
notes.ex1: AI systems can surpass humans in certain data-processing tasks. 人工智能系统在某些数据处理任务上能够超越人类。
notes.ex2: The company’s profits surpassed expectations this year. 该公司今年的利润超过了预期。

notes.en: a large quantity of something, especially information or written material
notes.zh: 大量，大批；令（纸张计量单位）
notes.ctx: reams of footage 指海量视频素材；ream 原是纸张计量单位，后引申为大量文件、数据或信息。
notes.ex1: Analysts examined reams of data to identify suspicious activity. 分析人员检查了海量数据，以识别可疑活动。
notes.ex2: The investigation produced reams of documents and reports. 这项调查产生了大量文件和报告。

notes.en: something valuable or useful that is not immediately obvious or easily noticed
notes.zh: 隐藏的宝藏，不易察觉的珍贵事物
notes.ctx: 比喻藏在海量监控画面里、不容易被发现却极有价值的情报线索，并非真的宝石。
notes.ex1: The algorithm uncovered hidden gems in millions of security recordings. 算法从数百万段安防录像中发现了隐藏的重要线索。
notes.ex2: The small bookstore is a hidden gem in the heart of the city. 这家小书店是市中心一处鲜为人知的宝藏。

paragraphs.en_html: Russia and Ukraine have <mark class="voc">ramped up</mark> camera-hacking in their war, aiming to spy on each other, find new targets and assess damage from their attacks. Israel, long a master of digital <mark class="voc">spycraft</mark>, hacked into Iranian traffic cameras to help forces collect intelligence used in the <mark class="voc">assassination</mark> of Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei earlier this year. Iran and its <mark class="voc">proxies</mark> have <mark class="voc">struck back</mark> by breaking into hundreds of Israeli webcams and security cameras that Israeli officials consider sensitive to national security, like the one on the chicken coop.
paragraphs.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰在战争中都加大了入侵摄像头的力度，试图借此相互刺探情报、寻找新的攻击目标，并评估袭击造成的损失。以色列长期以来精通数字间谍技术，今年早些时候曾入侵伊朗的交通摄像头，协助军方收集情报，这些情报随后被用于刺杀伊朗最高领袖阿里·哈梅内伊。伊朗及其代理势力则展开反击，侵入了数百台以色列网络摄像头和安防摄像头，其中包括鸡舍上的那一台。这些设备被以色列官员视为可能涉及国家安全的敏感设施。

notes.en: to increase the amount, level or intensity of an activity
notes.ctx: 指俄乌双方都在加码摄像头黑客攻击，让网络入侵成了战争情报的常规手段。
notes.ex1: Both sides ramped up cyber operations during the conflict. 冲突期间，双方都加大了网络行动的力度。
notes.ex2: The government ramped up security measures after the attack. 袭击发生后，政府加强了安全措施。

notes.en: the skills, methods and techniques used in espionage
notes.zh: 间谍技术，情报活动技巧
notes.ctx: digital spycraft 指用数字技术搞间谍活动、监视与情报收集，突出以色列在网络情报上的老到。
notes.ex1: Modern spycraft increasingly relies on digital surveillance and cyber operations. 现代间谍技术越来越依赖数字监控和网络行动。
notes.ex2: The novel offers a fascinating glimpse into the world of Cold War spycraft. 这部小说让读者得以一窥冷战时期的间谍世界。

notes.en: the deliberate killing of an important or well-known person, especially for political reasons
notes.ctx: 指针对伊朗最高领袖的定点刺杀，一句话把“偷看摄像头”与“炸到人头上去”连了起来。
notes.ex1: The assassination of the political leader shocked the nation. 这位政治领袖遭到暗杀，震惊了全国。
notes.ex2: Intelligence agencies uncovered a plot to carry out an assassination. 情报机构发现了一起暗杀阴谋。

notes.en: a person or group acting on behalf of another person, organization or country
notes.ctx: 指与伊朗有关联、代其利益出手的其他组织或势力；proxies 是复数形式。
notes.ex1: The country relied on regional proxies to extend its influence. 该国依靠地区代理势力扩大自身影响力。
notes.ex2: The conflict increasingly involved armed groups acting as proxies for larger powers. 这场冲突越来越多地涉及充当大国代理人的武装组织。

notes.en: to respond to an attack or harmful action by attacking in return
notes.ctx: 指伊朗及其代理势力反向入侵数百台以色列摄像头，以此前的网络与军事行动还以颜色。
notes.ex1: The hackers struck back by targeting government websites. 黑客通过攻击政府网站展开反击。
notes.ex2: The company struck back against its competitors with a cheaper product. 该公司推出价格更低的产品，反击竞争对手。

paragraphs.en_html: In 2024, Russian hackers <mark class="voc">commandeered</mark> residential webcams in Kyiv, including one installed by a <mark class="voc">condominium</mark> association to monitor the neighborhood. Ukraine’s security service, the SBU, said that Russia intended to use the hacked <mark class="voc">video feeds</mark> to find targets in the capital and “to adjust missile attacks on Ukraine,” <mark class="voc">refining</mark> their aim for <mark class="voc">subsequent</mark> strikes. The SBU said it has identified and secured, reoriented or blocked roughly 40,000 video cameras that <mark class="voc">posed</mark> potential security risks since Russia’s 2022 invasion.
paragraphs.zh: 2024年，俄罗斯黑客夺取了乌克兰首都基辅多台住宅网络摄像头的控制权，其中包括一台由公寓业主协会安装、原本用于监控周边社区的摄像头。乌克兰国家安全局（SBU）表示，俄罗斯打算利用这些被入侵的摄像头所传输的视频画面，在首都寻找攻击目标，并“调整对乌克兰的导弹袭击”，从而提高后续打击的精确度。乌克兰国家安全局还表示，自2022年俄罗斯发动入侵以来，该机构已识别出约4万台存在潜在安全风险的摄像头，并对其采取安全加固、调整朝向或封锁等措施。

notes.en: to take control or possession of something, often by force or without permission
notes.ctx: 指俄黑客不经许可夺走民用摄像头用于军事侦察，比 use 多了“强行占有”的意味。
notes.ex1: Hackers commandeered several webcams to monitor movements near the border. 黑客夺取了数台网络摄像头的控制权，以监视边境附近的活动。
notes.ex2: During the emergency, the military commandeered civilian vehicles. 紧急情况下，军方征用了民用车辆。

notes.en: a building containing individually owned apartments with shared common areas
notes.zh: 共有产权公寓，产权式公寓
notes.ctx: 指业主各持单元、共同管理公共区域的住宅；condominium association 即公寓业主协会，装摄像头只是为了看小区。
notes.ex1: The condominium association installed cameras to improve neighborhood security. 公寓业主协会安装了摄像头，以改善社区安全。
notes.ex2: She purchased a condominium near the city center. 她在市中心附近买了一套产权公寓。

notes.en: a continuous stream of video images transmitted from a camera or another source
notes.ctx: 指被入侵摄像头源源不断传出的画面，黑客靠它盯目标区域，再给导弹打击提供依据。
notes.ex1: The security team monitored live video feeds from cameras across the building. 安保团队监看着大楼各处摄像头传来的实时视频画面。
notes.ex2: Hackers gained access to the video feed from a residential webcam. 黑客获取了一台住宅网络摄像头的视频流。

notes.en: to improve something by making small changes or adjustments
notes.ctx: 指依据摄像头情报修正后续导弹袭击的瞄准，refining their aim 强调一点点把准头校出来。
notes.ex1: The military used surveillance data to refine its targeting methods. 军方利用监控数据改进目标瞄准方法。
notes.ex2: Scientists continued to refine the model as new data became available. 随着新数据不断出现，科学家持续完善模型。

notes.en: happening or coming after something else
notes.ctx: 指在先前的袭击与情报分析之后打的下一轮，强调这次的情报是为了下一次的打击。
notes.ex1: The information was used to plan subsequent military operations. 这些信息被用于规划后续军事行动。
notes.ex2: The initial mistake caused serious problems in subsequent stages of the project. 最初的错误给项目后续阶段带来了严重问题。

notes.en: to cause or present a problem, danger or threat
notes.zh: 造成，构成（威胁、风险或问题）
notes.ctx: pose potential security risks 指摄像头可能对国家安全构成潜在风险；这里的 pose 是“构成”，不是“摆姿势”。
notes.ex1: Unsecured cameras may pose serious risks to national security. 缺乏安全防护的摄像头可能对国家安全构成严重风险。
notes.ex2: Climate change poses a major threat to coastal communities. 气候变化对沿海社区构成重大威胁。
